notes.subject: Zion/Jerusalem
notes.rationale: Feminine singular imperatives address Zion as a woman.

notes.subject: אורי / אורך / זרח
notes.rationale: Verb 'shine' echoed in noun 'your light' and verb 'rise (of sun)' — chain of light-words partly lost in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: glori
notes.rationale: כבוד is 'weight/heaviness' figuratively splendor; Tok Pisin has no weight-sense word, 'glori' keeps only splendor.

translation: Kamap sanap, kamap lait, bilong lait bilong yu i kamap pinis, na glori bilong Yahwe i sanap long yu olsem san i stat.

tokens.gloss: i sanap olsem san i stat
